verdict.rationale: CIPO is a government IP office with online filing services, a MyCIPO account login and downloadable bulk data, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents API keys, tokens or least-privilege scoping. The MyCIPO login is a human account portal and keyless public search is not credential issuance; both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
